title: Relative incidence comparison with inert source blocks
statement:
Use spaces, homotopy fibers and homotopy limits of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], the universe, quasicategory and mapping-space conventions of [def-coef-complete-algebroid] and generalized nonsymmetric infinity operads of [lem-coef-operadic-algebra-presentability]. Let $Q\to\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}$ be such an operad, let $C\in Q_{[k]}$ with $k\geq1$, and fix its entire inert incidence projection diagram, with edge objects $C_i\in Q_{[1]}$ and vertex objects $V_j\in Q_{[0]}$. Fix $D\in Q_{[n]}$ and an active base arrow $\alpha:[n]\to[k]$. Put $t_j=\alpha^{\mathrm{op}}(j)$, $n_i=t_i-t_{i-1}$, and choose inert cocartesian block projections $q_i:D\to D_i$ over the interval $[t_{i-1},t_i]$. Let $\beta_i:[n_i]\to[1]$ be active, and let $\eta_j:[k]\to[0]$ select the $j$th vertex. For each incidence $j=i-1,i$, compose an arrow $b_i\in\operatorname{Map}^{\beta_i}_Q(D_i,C_i)$ with $q_i$ and the corresponding endpoint projection $C_i\to V_j$. This defines the edge-to-vertex maps of a diagram $T_{D,C,\alpha}$ with edge values $\operatorname{Map}^{\beta_i}_Q(D_i,C_i)$ and vertex values $\operatorname{Map}^{\eta_j\alpha}_Q(D,V_j)$. Its homotopy limit retains the endpoint composition homotopies and all higher simplices. Restriction followed by cocartesian factorization induces an equivalence
$$\operatorname{Map}^{\alpha}_Q(D,C)\simeq\operatorname{holim} T_{D,C,\alpha}.$$
This comparison is coherent in equivalences of $D$ over $\operatorname{id}_{[n]}$ and their induced block equivalences, and in equivalences of the chosen inert projection diagrams. Thus its homotopy fiber over any specified compatible block-and-vertex datum is contractible. Zero-length blocks are included. No groupoid assumption on $Q_{[1]}$ is required.
